title: 0DTE Index Options and Market Volatility: How Large is Their Impact?
one_line: Follow-up on 0DTE volatility effects: on average 0DTE trading is associated with dampened, not amplified, S&P intraday volatility; related work (Adams et al.) finds realized volatility ~60 bp lower on 0DTE days and that higher dealer net gamma predicts reversals in E-mini order flow over the next 10-60 minutes.

findings.statement: 0DTE impact on index volatility is small / dampening on average.
Related: net dealer gamma predicts lower 10-minute volatility and stronger reversals in E-mini flow (Adams et al.).

why.pattern: Long-gamma dealer hedging dampens intraday moves.
